blocks.html: The last few months of the year are known as the awards season for the real estate industry. And in the recently held 9th PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards (Philippines), RLC Residences and its standout properties victoriously gained distinctions and commendations in this year’s design and development categories.

The region’s leading real estate awards program awarded The Magnolia Residences as the winner in the Best Mega Mixed-Use Architectural Design category. Situated within the Robinsons Magnolia Town Center in New Manila, Quezon City, this four-tower property provides the utmost comfort to homeowners with its convenient access to the neighboring mall, hotel, and other essential establishments.

RLC Residences also received Special Recognitions in ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and Sustainable Design and Construction for their green practices and other socially responsible initiatives such as community service, waste management, and eco-friendly design features.

Highly commended distinction in the Best Lifestyle Developer category is also given to RLC Residences. At the same time, The Sapphire Bloc and Galleria Residences Cebu are recognized for Best High-End Condo Development in Metro Manila and Metro Cebu, respectively. On the other hand, SYNC and The Residences at The Westin Manila Sonata Place are also acknowledged for the Best Condo Architectural Design and Best Condo Interior Design categories.

With the challenges brought about by the pandemic, RLC Residences has strengthened its efforts in further raising the bar in real estate development by building homes that improve the quality of living. The brand maintains its promise of building beautiful and well-designed homes that every stakeholder will be proud of.
Learn more about RLC Residences and its award-winning and highly commended properties by visiting www.rlcresidences.com.
